facts.t: She eats supper standing at the door of the family's small dining room, so she can watch the corridor and the table at once.
She notes that there had been four at her own family's house.
She tells Chang'e's father a soldier can carry thirty kilos, or twenty if she has to run far.
Nobody had called her Big Sis in front of people before, and she does not correct it.
On her night round she finds Chang'e asleep at the bench, switches off the soldering iron and carries her to bed.
Her father's bench sounded like a rifle bolt, with clocks on the wall; the night the roof came down every lamp died, but the clocks he wound by hand kept ticking.
She tells Chang'e she always hits her target.
For the first time her hand does not stop halfway, and she rests it on Chang'e's head.
She sights with both eyes open: her real eye and her teal one.
For years she watched Ender cores die from the station wall, and she knows they burn from the middle.
At the rail yard she aims at the edge of an Ender's core instead of its middle, which she had never seen anyone try.
Her shot brings a core piece back whole, which nobody had thought could be done.
An officer tells her the whole core piece makes her the most valuable shot the Shield has, and sends her on a top secret mission.
She has never refused an order in the Shield.
Her brother held her sleeve every night and she promised him every night; he died anyway, and she has promised no one anything since.
She promises Chang'e she will come back.
She will never tell anyone what the mission was.
Back in Terrinia she takes an officer's radio handset and commands the leaderless squads to hold the avenues.
Her rifle barrel grows so hot it burns through her left glove, and she does not let go.
She sees the giant walking toward the base and realizes the fight at the edge is a decoy.
She shoots the Ender that is about to strike Chang'e at the crater.
She holds Chang'e and says she is sorry, and Chang'e pushes her away.
Once she sat in the rain between her own parents, so she knows Chang'e's loss better than anyone.
From a far roof she keeps the lab's lit window in her rifle sights all night, and again the next night.
Months after the fall she is made a commander of the Shield's combat division.
She asks the Shield only for a cold room at the top of an old tower across the water, because its window faces the lab.
She sleeps in a hard chair facing the window, and her dream always ends on Chang'e's voice.
She thinks that ever since that day she vowed to keep Chang'e safe.
She turns her lamp up full and stands in the lit window, so the Ender sees her and turns its open chest toward her.
Her first words to Chang'e since the crater are an order: focus on the fight.
Her round and Chang'e's crescent hit the giant's open chest together.
Later the Academy calls her and Chang'e the First Aspirants.
She tells the Shield's officers that imagination is Chang'e's weapon, and she only aims it.
At the founding she becomes Selrick Academy's Chief Combat Instructor, head of its Combat Division.
For weeks she walks the city's children's homes with stamped sheets and picks children for the Academy.
She never sleeps on her cot; she sleeps upright in the hard chair, boots on, facing the door.
Years later she still cannot tell Chang'e what the mission was.
She keeps Chang'e off the field rotation because in the field she cannot see her, and the last time she was away Chang'e's parents died.
She keeps the old action under the new coil because Chang'e built it.
As Chief Combat Instructor she declares Ruby and Angela Aspirants.

ties.t: She watches over Chang'e and carries her to bed.
Together they are the First Aspirants.
Chang'e calls her Big Sis and holds her coat; she sits beside her.
She takes her hand at the gate.
He lays a hand on her shoulder once.
Her mother; Lesley once sat in the rain between her parents.
She guards its gate and signs its gate log.
A Shield soldier who has never refused an order.
She becomes one of its commanders.
She takes command of them on the night the base fell.
Chief Combat Instructor, head of the Academy's Combat Division.
One of its first two heads.
She chooses them with the dial.
She picks him as one of her instructors.

ties.with: the officer with gray in his beard
ties.t: He hands her his radio handset.
She accepts his order to go on the mission.
Her shot breaks it off whole.
She keeps a room at its top.
She addresses Layla among the four in combat suits.
She addresses Fanny among the four in combat suits.

gear.name: Lesley's rifle
gear.t: A red and gold bolt rifle Chang'e built for her birthday. It has no cell and no cable: a spring, a pin and a bolt.

gear.name: the new coil
gear.t: A new coil she fits on top of the rifle's old action.

gear.name: the old Shield rifle
gear.t: Her earlier Shield rifle, the tape on its stock hanging in strips.

gear.name: the teal eye
gear.t: Her left eye, which draws targets in thin teal lines.

gear.name: the visor
gear.t: A visor she touches after the dream.

gear.name: the comm
gear.t: A comm at her collar with a small green light; the base and the Shield can both reach her on it.

gear.name: the armband
gear.t: The armband that makes her a commander of the Shield's combat division.

facts.t: She gives Lesley the fourth chair at the table, the one that faces the door.
Too small for the big bench, she stands on a box to reach it.
She calls Lesley Big Sis in front of a researcher and threatens to tell on him.
She weighs less than twenty kilos.
Found asleep at the bench, she says she is thinking with her eyes shut.
Her mother says never to argue with her, because she enjoys it.
After seeing Lesley come back muddy from the city's edge, she decides to build a rifle that can hit Enders from farther away.
She builds the rifle alone; the year before, her father's hands set the smallest parts of the eye.
Holding the core piece bare-handed, she sees a light wake in it and says it listens to her.
She wears glasses and pushes them up her nose.
After two weeks of tests she concludes the piece cares what she believes, not what she knows, and only while she holds on.
She realizes that if belief lights a core, a soldier could light one too, and plans a frame for a soldier to wear.
At the gate she makes Lesley promise to come back.
At the first light she keeps her palm on the copper plate and thinks of Lesley coming home.
As her family runs for the shelter she shuts her eyes and lets her mother's hand pull her.
Her parents shove her out from between them and stand between her and the giant's light.
Kneeling at the crater, she blames herself: she had her eyes shut and let them pull her.
When Lesley holds her and says sorry, she pushes her away and says to leave her alone.
On the night of the fall she refuses to go to the shelter and stays in the lab.
She writes in her log that she will never forgive Lesley, and saves it unsent.
Told about a children's home in the city, she asks who would finish the frame.
Under her mother's last word "Next:" she writes: make it something a soldier can wear.
She replaces the word belief with aspirant power, because belief sits still and this reaches.
She becomes Chief Scientist, the youngest Terrinia has ever had, which was her parents' title.
She builds the crescents so that nobody has to push her clear again.
Told her mother would want her in the shelter, she answers that her mother never reached it.
She stands alone in front of the seawall shelter's doors to protect the people inside.
Thrown down and alone, she asks where Lesley is; her gear's log records it.
Seeing Lesley in the lit window, she thinks: she came.
At the sight of the giant her legs stop, as they did at the crater.
The morning after, she takes a fistful of Lesley's coat and calls her Big Sis.
She proposes finding children young and teaching them in pairs, because her crescents flew farther with Lesley at her back.
She drives the stake for the Academy hall into the crater's floor.
At the founding she becomes director of the Science Division.
She has never asked who her own first parents were.
She calls Mr. Bunny her best friend and will not let anyone take him.
Her log holds forty-three unsent one-line drafts to Lesley, all about work.
She finally asks Lesley where she was that day; she stopped being angry long ago.
She tells Lesley that as long as it was Lesley's fault, it was not her parents' fault, or hers.
She falls asleep with her head against Lesley's arm.

ties.t: Her first parents, whom she never asked about.
Lesley watches over her and carries her to bed.
Together they are the First Aspirants.
She makes him the first Science Division professor.
She proposes the school, to stand where the first light was.
She builds it for Lesley's birthday.
She built it the year before, with her father setting the smallest parts.
She has the idea and fits the copper plate in its palm.
She finishes them in the years after the fall.
She builds it to read aspirant power.
She seals a core inside it.
She buys it at the salvage stall.
She looks for the girl from the salvage stall and approves her entry.
She examines Angela and keeps her on checks.
She thinks it is the giant that killed her parents.
She fights them with her crescents.
She works and sleeps at its console.

gear.name: Mr. Bunny
gear.t: A floating robot with a screen for a face that follows her and helps; once he grows into a giant rabbit-head machine.

gear.name: the crescents
gear.t: White crescents edged with pink that circle her in a ring and strike when an Ender opens its chest.

gear.name: the panels of light
gear.t: Panels of light she calls up with "Console! Activate!" to read a target.

gear.name: the design log
gear.t: Her log, where every entry is written to Lesley.

gear.name: the glove and dial
gear.t: Her gauge for aspirant power.

facts.t: At the first intake a girl with pink-red twin-tails, whose sheet lists a long line of scientists, puts her hand in the glove, and the needle hits the stop with a click.
She answers Lesley without slowing, walks on to the far door and never looks back to see who is behind her.
Chang'e calls hers the best reading of the day.
Lesley notes that she does not look back, which is bad in a pair.
Her name heads the Combat Division's first intake list.
Late for class, she gallops along the school roof, thinking nobody checks it.
She scolds Fanny that flying is banned.
She complains that this time they will have the book thrown at them.
She hears herself say that at least they will be in detention together, and studies the ceiling.
In the mop race she slides the last meters on her back on the wet floor; Ruby wins.
She has messages from home that she has not answered.
She eyes the new coil on Lesley's rifle and wants it in pieces on her desk.
She decides the movement at the corner of Lesley's mouth was a smile.
She notes that nobody tows Lesley.
She lies down in the grass an arm's length from Fanny, telling herself it is only because the grass is warm.
She says, too fast, that she is not interested in the outside world and has not been sneaking a peek.
She does not let herself think about three small leaves under a glass dome.
She watches Fanny's raised hand from the corner of her eye.
At the ceremony she stands shoulder to shoulder with Fanny in combat suits, not arguing.
Guinevere has spoken to her exactly once, at the fish market.
She knows Guinevere from a billboard.
She and Vexana have shared classes for two years, and neither ever spoke first.
She keeps score: Vexana spoke first, so one to her.
At the fish market she tells Fanny "Behind me" and goes first.

ties.t: Together they are the Layla-Fanny Team.
She goes out with the third years from the gate portal.
Lesley gives her speech about trust to Layla and the others.
Joe assigns her team its place in the raid.

gear.name: combat suit
gear.t: She wears a combat suit at the ceremony.

facts.t: She tackles Layla flat on the roof so she will not be seen.
She flew up with her hip thrusters, which are still ticking.
She agrees flying is banned on school grounds, but argues for sneaking in a little flight.
She hauls Layla up and races her down the spiral stairwell; they roll out in a heap.
It is her first detention, and she asked the teacher what to bring.
In the mop race she comes third, after stopping to set out a wet-floor sign.
She scrubs the floor side by side with Layla, neither calling it a race.
She has looked up at the sky a lot since Ruby said Oro lies in another galaxy.
She wonders aloud if there is another her on the other side of the sky.
Lying in the grass, she raises one hand toward the dome's pale light and spreads her fingers.
At the ceremony she stands shoulder to shoulder with Layla in combat suits.
At the fish market she draws her blades and says "Let's do our best together."

ties.t: Together they are the Layla-Fanny Team.
Lesley gives her speech about trust to Fanny and the others.

gear.name: hip thrusters
gear.t: Thrusters at her hips that let her fly.

gear.name: blades
gear.t: Blades she draws for the fight.

gear.name: combat suit
gear.t: She wears a combat suit at the ceremony.

facts.t: She greets Chang'e as Teacher Chang'e, in her perfect voice.
She pulled the Council's control unit out of Angela to keep her safe.
She hid a locked safeguard in Angela's code that opens only to her hand, so she can stop Angela if Oro ever takes her again.
She sweetly asks Chang'e to put her on the list too.
Green lines run from her glove into the doll's back, and she cuts its link to Oro in four seconds.
She asks to read Mr. Bunny's code in return: fair is fair.
Chang'e sees Angela as her best friend.
Lesley had already asked her the entry question on the landing lot.
Her needle on the dial passes the line with room to spare.
A white droid follows her everywhere and watches her with its orange eye.
She earned detention by feeding a ten-minute recording of herself into her droid's camera, over and over, for an hour.
She spent the hour eating a bun in the sun until Lesley found her on the third bite.
She straddles her mop like a horse, races and wins.
She says home is like a golden birdcage, lightly, like a joke; nobody laughs.
She politely wipes around Chang'e's face pressed to the window.
Her cloth stops mid-stroke when Lesley's eye rests on her.
She has told the others Oro lies in another galaxy.
At the ceremony she grounds her scythe and keeps her eyes on the floor in front of Lesley's boots.
Lesley makes her an Aspirant.

ties.t: She removed the control unit so Angela is safe.
She placed it in Angela's code.

gear.name: scythe
gear.t: A scythe she grounds at the ceremony.

gear.name: glove
gear.t: A glove that sends green lines into a machine; she uses it to cut the doll's link.

gear.name: combat suit
gear.t: She wears a combat suit at the ceremony.

facts.t: She carries a doll in the crook of her arm.
In the lab she looks at the door, not at the instruments.
She answers Chang'e's questions on joint torque, sensor reach and cooling in a small, careful voice.
On a record she once struck students with red eyes, a beat late, doing what someone else told her.
An empty socket between her shoulder blades shows where the Council's control unit was.
Chang'e keeps her on checks, because anything that can receive can be told what to do.
Her hands tighten on the table when she hears it.
Forty hidden lines, locked and marked DANGER, lie under her walking routines.
She refuses to give up her doll, then gives it to Ruby.
A fault in her chest comes whenever she thinks about the friends she lost, and she does not want it fixed.
Whatever drives her shield, the dial reads it as aspirant power.
She comes to detention though nobody sentenced her.
She watches Ruby's face when Ruby calls home a golden birdcage.
At the ceremony her doll is clipped at her hip.
Lesley makes her an Aspirant.

ties.t: She trusts Ruby with her doll.
Ruby removed the control unit to keep her safe.

gear.name: Angela's doll
gear.t: A doll whose left eye is a camera; its link to Oro is cut.

gear.name: shield
gear.t: Her shield, whose drive the dial reads as aspirant power.

gear.name: combat suit
gear.t: She wears a combat suit at the ceremony.

facts.t: She is on the Combat Division's first intake list as Guinevere of House Baroque.
In school uniform she waves her whole arm at Vexana and wears a chibi keychain of a black-haired Vexana.
She takes a fistful of Vexana's sleeve and tows her out into the light.
She has pink hair.
She introduces herself to Layla as the great lady Guinevere.
She is on a billboard and is delighted that Layla knows it.
She walks into the gate portal's light as if it had been lit for her.
She fights in the air on wings of light, at the mouth of the tear in the dome.
Two round gray drones with cat ears and yellow ring eyes circle her; drones and wings both run on her aspirant power.
She fights Enders with her fists.
Her drones pour light into an Ender's open chest, and her fist goes in after it.
She never looks back to check, trusting that Vexana is there.
Tired around the thirtieth minute, she tells herself a great lady does not land early and punches harder.
Her wings go out like a switch, and she falls.
Pulled back up by Vexana, she calls it a lady's refinement: regaining elegance in three seconds.
She fights the rest of the raid on the tiles with one drone.
She sleeps with the lamp off and the door open a hand's width, with stuffed animals along the wall side of her bed.
She tells Vexana the fall was only a crosswind.
Lying awake, she counts one, two, three under her breath, the way someone used to count for her.
As a small child she fell on the garden stair, and Hester counted her up.
Her oldest memory is candlelight and a voice counting in the dark.
She learns the voice was Hester's, on the storm night her mother did not come home.
From that night on she sleeps with her door open.
She wears her mother's two red bows, ties them herself and lets nobody else touch them.
She never leaves the House without guards.
She eats at one end of the long table, her father's chair empty most nights.
She redoes her accounts on the bench outside her father's office, her feet not reaching the floor.
She has a cake baked for her father's birthday; the plate comes back washed.
She ties the manners tutor's words to Hester's count: a lady's refinement, three seconds.
The guards are her only company; she carries cakes out to them herself.
When she falls in the long hall and nobody comes, she counts herself up.
Hester teaches her to punch, and she hits the sandbag every dawn before lessons.
At board meetings she counts the people inside the numbers: a ward is streets, and streets are families.
Her father names her heir to his seat on the board.
She thinks nothing in the board's room is hers.
Seeing the first suits fly, she decides money cannot buy those wings, so if she wins them they are hers.
She makes a bargain in her head: if she comes first with none of his money, her father will have to see.
She wants to hear him say "Well done, Guinevere."
She tells Hester to wait at the car and touches her two red bows.
She walks into the Academy with her chin up and cold hands, and does not look back.

ties.t: They fight as a pair; Guinevere trusts Vexana is there.
Each wears a keychain of the other.
Joe assigns her and Vexana the east end.
They teach her accounts, contracts and manners.
She introduces herself to Layla before the raid.

gear.name: Guinevere's drones
gear.t: Two round gray drones with cat ears and yellow ring eyes that run on her aspirant power and pour light into an open Ender chest.

gear.name: wings of light
gear.t: Wings of light that hold her in the air.

gear.name: the two red bows
gear.t: Her mother's two red bows, worn in her hair.

gear.name: chibi keychain
gear.t: A keychain doll of a black-haired Vexana at her belt.

gear.name: phone
gear.t: Her phone, on which Vexana calls her each night.

facts.t: She is on the Combat Division's first intake list.
She waits by the hall door in school uniform with folded arms, a chibi keychain of a pink-haired Guinevere at her belt.
She lets Guinevere tow her out by the sleeve.
She has black hair, violet eyes and a small mole beside her mouth.
She gives Layla her name only in case it is needed.
She and Layla have shared classes for two years without either speaking first.
She follows Guinevere into the portal without a word.
She keeps to the roof below Guinevere, where she sees the tear and the street, and her staff finishes whatever Guinevere knocks down.
Her bolt frees Guinevere's boot from a claw.
When Guinevere's wings fail, she lies flat on the tiles and catches her by the wrist.
She counts under her breath while Guinevere recovers, and says "Four."
Her hand shakes afterward, and she grips her staff until it stops.
She saw Guinevere tiring a minute before and said nothing.
On an earlier raid she told Guinevere to come down and rest, and Guinevere flew higher; so now she waits at the roof's edge instead.
For the rest of the raid she stands a step nearer and fires over Guinevere's shoulder.
She picks up Guinevere's broken drone and takes it back through the portal ahead of the others, saying nothing.
She phones Guinevere at the usual hour to tell her to go to bed, and hangs up.
On the morning of the entrance assessment a black-haired girl with a cloth bag goes past Guinevere at the gate, eyes front.

ties.t: Her staff finishes what Guinevere knocks down.
She catches Guinevere when she falls.
Each wears a keychain of the other.
Joe assigns her and Guinevere the east end.

gear.name: staff
gear.t: A staff that fires bolts.

gear.name: chibi keychain
gear.t: A keychain doll of a pink-haired Guinevere at her belt.

gear.name: cloth bag
gear.t: A cloth bag she carries on the day of the entrance assessment.

gear.name: phone
gear.t: Her phone, on which she calls Guinevere each night.

facts.t: A blonde girl, older than Chang'e, comes to the base's outer fence most evenings to watch its machines through the wire.
When Chang'e waves at her, she does not wave back.
Chang'e recognizes her on the Science Division's first list as the girl from the salvage stall.
She keeps a trestle table at the city's edge, and she mended an old servo there with a trick Chang'e had never seen.
Asked what she mended it with, she says "Hands."
She sold the servo to Chang'e for every coin in Chang'e's pockets and two jelly candies.
The family-name box beside her name is empty and glows red.
Chang'e takes her for a child with no family, like many in the city.
Chang'e lays her thumb on the box and it turns green, approving her entry.
He is a floating robot with a screen for a face; he yawns on it as he follows Chang'e.
He helps push crates from the other side, though it does nothing, because he likes to help.
He fetches whatever Chang'e points at.
Each morning his screen shows the number of days since Lesley left.
Chang'e gives him a homecoming face for Lesley, with one round eye and one teal eye that winks.
During the attack he is left dark on the bench with his casing open.
Switched back on after the fall, he shows the homecoming face, and Chang'e wipes it away.
His lens shows what he sees; night after night he turns to the window where Lesley watches from a rooftop.
A blow sends him spinning away over the rooftops.
At Chang'e's call he comes back as a great white rabbit-head machine taller than the storefronts, his screen as big as a door, and the Enders break against him.
Chang'e thinks that size had never worked in the yard.
At dawn he is his own size again, his screen dimmed.
His sleeping face is two flat lines and a small Z.
When Ruby asks to read his code, his screen goes blank.
Chang'e calls him her best friend.
Chang'e uses him as her excuse to visit Lesley: he was lonely.
His screen dims when nobody needs him.

ties.t: He fetches what she points at.

things.name: the researcher
aliases: the researcher who gave her the big bench

facts.t: He tells Chang'e the big bench is for grown-ups and sends her back to her corner.
When Lesley appears silently in the doorway, he finds work at the far end of the lab.
After seeing the first light, he tells Chang'e the big bench is hers.
On the night the base fell he carries Chang'e in from the yard and puts his own coat round her.
He brings her soup and suggests a children's home in the city; after her answer he never says home again.
He tells her finishing the frame will not bring her parents back.
When the Enders return he blocks her way and says her mother would want her in the shelter.
He never left the base, and Chang'e makes him the first of the Science Division's professors.

ties.t: He looks after her after the fall.

facts.t: She sets out a fourth plate at supper for Lesley.
She gets Chang'e to take a pill by not arguing, and tells Lesley never to argue with her, because she enjoys it.
She begins every project by writing who it is for.
She handles anything taken off an Ender only in gloves.
She tells Chang'e a guess is not a claim, and makes her test it.
Her notes for the frame begin: For whoever has to stand in front.
At the gate she holds out her hand to Lesley and promises to set her plate.
She says that if it only works once, it does not work.
She names the moment the frame holds the first light, and her voice cracks.
She writes "First light" under the page pinned to the frame.
She does up the top button of Chang'e's coat, the one Chang'e always forgets.
Running for the shelter, she calls Lesley on the radio from her coat and gets only hiss.
She and Chang'e's father shove Chang'e clear and stand between her and the giant's light.
After the light, the crater where they stood is empty.
Her last notebook entry stops at the word "Next:"
She and Chang'e's father held the title of Chief Scientists.
At the old bench she used to hand round caramel pudding, one cup each.
Her small quick handwriting is on the label tape of an old servo at the salvage stall.

ties.t: She shoves Chang'e clear of the light.
Chang'e's two parents; his arm goes round her shoulders as they run.
They test the core piece together at their bench.
Lesley takes her hand at the gate.

facts.t: He eats in silence, as he always does.
He writes Lesley's numbers for a soldier's load on his napkin and keeps it.
The year before, his hands set the smallest parts of the eye.
He lifts cores out of the raid crate with tongs and bins the burned ones.
When Chang'e plans a frame for a soldier, he lays the folded napkin beside her bowl.
He bends steel tube into a person's shape a head taller than Lesley and weighs every plate he bolts on.
At the gate he lays a hand on Lesley's shoulder, once.
He counts the days Lesley is gone too, but will not say so.
After the first light he nearly smiles and tells Chang'e her hand did that.
During the attack he tells Chang'e to leave Mr. Bunny and stay close; his voice is always calm.
He counts the fifty steps to the shelter aloud and stops at twenty.
He and Chang'e's mother turn to face the giant, with Chang'e between them.
Chang'e thinks her father would have had the count of the queue by now.

ties.t: He shoves Chang'e clear of the light.
Chang'e's two parents; his arm goes round her shoulders as they run.
His hands set its smallest parts.
He lays a hand on her shoulder.
He keeps it in his pocket.

facts.t: Chang'e has never asked who they were.
He held Lesley's sleeve every night and she promised him every night; she kept it, and he died anyway.
His bench sounded like a rifle bolt, with clocks on the wall; the clocks he wound by hand kept ticking the night the roof came down.
Lesley once sat in the rain between him and her mother.
Lesley once sat in the rain between her parents.

things.name: the sergeant at the rail yard

facts.t: He stares at the whole core piece and says Ender cores always burn.

ties.t: Sergeant of the squad Lesley saved.

facts.t: He posted Lesley to the base, and he comes out in person because he will not give these orders over the comm.
He tells her Headquarters calls the whole core piece a miracle and sends her on a top secret mission.
He orders no radio and no letters, because the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals.
He says another soldier will take her gate.
He drives Lesley back toward Terrinia and expects to be home by one.
He brakes hard on the last hill when he sees the city's edge burning.

things.name: the officer with gray in his beard

facts.t: He has gray in his beard and a rank armband on his sleeve, and nobody on the channel listens to him.
He knows Lesley by the rail yard shot.
He hands Lesley his radio handset, and the squads answer her.
Months later he brings Lesley the armband that makes her a commander of the Shield's combat division.
He tells her the squads asked for her because she held the avenues.
He leads the Shield's officers who come to see Chang'e's suits.
He points out that no Shield soldier could lift an arm in the suits.
He asks who will keep the suits running.

ties.t: He gives her command on the night the base fell.

facts.t: He warns Lesley the tower room is cold and nobody wants it.
The warden hauls at one of the seawall shelter's iron doors, ready to shut it.
The warden shouts at Chang'e to get in.

things.name: the small girl at the shelter

facts.t: A man runs past Chang'e with a small girl on his hip, and a woman beside them holds her hand; the girl has her eyes shut.
They reach the shelter's doors with ten steps to spare.
At dawn she rides out of the shelter on her father's hip with her eyes open.

ties.t: Chang'e guards the doors she ran through.

facts.t: He reads Chang'e's report and stops at the line where she crossed out belief.
He copies the word aspirant power into his own report.
He frowns that Chang'e's plan is a school, not a regiment.
A young Shield soldier with a monocle, he passes Lesley's dial test and becomes one of the first instructors.
Now Professor Joe, still on his cane, sees the third years off at the gate portal every day.
He assigns the fish-market raid: the Layla-Fanny Team to the west end, Guinevere and Vexana to the east.

ties.t: One of the Academy's first instructors.
A Shield soldier Lesley fought beside.
He sees them off on raids.
She chooses him as an instructor.

facts.t: The teacher waits at the classroom door with folded arms when Layla and Fanny arrive late.
Fanny asked the teacher what to bring to detention.
After the fish-market raid a medic tapes Guinevere's wrist.
Someone used to count for Guinevere whenever she fell.
She is the first person who ever counted for Guinevere.
She wears a gray coat, belongs to the House's guard and never laughs.
When small Guinevere falls on the garden stair, she says "Up, miss. One. Two. Three."
After that she counts three at every fall.
She tells the story of Guinevere's mother the way she gives a report.
As the newest guard in the House, she carried baby Guinevere down to the cellar with one candle on the storm night, counting the steps aloud so she would not cry.
After telling the story, she leaves the door open; her footsteps go, stop and come back.
She never tells that story again.
She kept back Guinevere's mother's two red bows when the House cleared her rooms, and ties them in Guinevere's hair.
Guinevere's father puts her at the head of his daughter's guard detail.
She eats her cake standing up.
She learned to fight from an old Shield sergeant before the House hired her, and finally agrees to teach Guinevere.
She teaches: elbow in, hip first, hands home after every punch.
She drives Guinevere across the city to the Academy's entrance assessment.
She waits beside the car in her gray coat, where Guinevere told her to wait.

ties.t: Head of the detail around Guinevere.
He puts her at the head of the detail.
She learned to fight from this sergeant.

facts.t: Her portrait hangs in the long hall.
On the storm night she was working late at the House's bank by the harbor, and she did not come home.
The two red bows came from her dressing table.
Guinevere's father lost her to the Enders.
At dawn after the storm night he stood in his office door a long time, then shut it.
He holds the head seat on the board that runs House Baroque.
He puts a detail of guards around his daughter, led by Hester.
He lost his wife to the Enders; Guinevere later works out that to him money buys walls, so money is safety, though he never says so.
His chair at the far end of the long table stands empty most nights, and he speaks to Guinevere through his office door.
He marks a mistake on her first page of sums and says "Again."
He keeps her second page.
He returns her birthday cake plate washed, with no word.
The long hall is the master's; the guards never enter it.
When Guinevere falls in the long hall, his pen keeps scratching behind his door.
At board meetings he sits at the head, a fur collar over his chair.
He tells the board his daughter will take a junior seat when she comes of age, and his seat after him.
When she says she will sit the Academy's assessment, he says only that she will be home within the year, and does not forbid it.

ties.t: He sits at the head of its table.

facts.t: This old Shield sergeant taught Hester to fight before the House hired her.
Tutors come to teach Guinevere accounts, contracts and manners.
The manners tutor talks all day about a lady's refinement, meaning how you hold your back.
It calls Lesley out to fight at the city's edge.
It can reach Lesley through the comm at her collar.
Its headquarters calls the whole core piece a miracle.
It thinks the Enders can hear its signals, so the secret mission has no radio and no letters.
On the night the base fell its channel is full of cut-off squads with nobody in command.
Months after the fall its combat division gets Lesley as a commander.
None of the soldiers it sends can make Chang'e's suits lift an arm.
Its officers come with the city's scientists to see the suits.
The officers laugh at Chang'e until Lesley looks at them.
Lesley picks the Academy's first instructors from Shield soldiers she fought beside.
The Academy's first instructors are Shield soldiers.

ties.t: Its squads hold the avenues of the city.

facts.t: It calls Lesley's whole core piece a miracle.
Lesley becomes one of its commanders months after the fall.
Before her first raid in command, a boy at the end of the line asks what they do if the Enders run; she answers that not a single enemy will escape.
At the rail yard a squad goes to ground behind a wagon while an Ender reaches for it.
On the night the base fell Third squad is cut off, and nobody answers the calls for a commander.
Lesley orders all squads to her to hold the avenues, and Second and Fourth answer.
They hold, barely.
Every squad that might have stopped the giant is out at the edge with Lesley.
The squads ask for Lesley as their commander.
A week after the fall Lesley gets the Shield to post two soldiers she trusts on the base's gate.
If Chang'e asks who sent them, they are to say the Shield.
When the Enders return they fire up the avenue and shout after Chang'e as she runs past.
Three of the night shift come to the lab door when the first light holds.
During the attack researchers run down the red corridor with their arms full.
After the fall two of them come with the researcher, bringing bread and blankets to Chang'e.
Chang'e calls her parents' old team back as the Science Division's professors.
They come to see Chang'e's suits.
They make Chang'e Chief Scientist.
They come with the Shield's officers to hear Chang'e's plan.
Lesley heads it as Chief Combat Instructor.
Children whose needle passes the line go through the far door to its preparatory course.
Its first intake lists Layla, Guinevere of House Baroque, Vexana and the rest.
Its first professors are the researcher who gave Chang'e the big bench and the rest of her parents' old team.
Chang'e becomes its director.
Its first list includes Selena near the end.
Layla takes the new coil on Lesley's rifle for Science Division work.
Children whose needle stops short of the line go through the left door to the Support Division.
Lesley picks them with the dial from Shield soldiers she fought beside; most needles stop short of the line.
The first of them climbs into a suit and lifts its arms.
At the founding they open wings of light and fly in a line over the gate, the crowd and the roofs.
Guinevere's House learns they are Shield soldiers flying the first finished suits.
On a record Angela once struck students with red eyes.
At the ceremony the other students stand along the walls in uniform.
Afterward they go out past Chang'e in twos.
One of Chang'e's unsent lines says their suits passed inspection.
Professor Joe sees them off at the gate portal every day; most days it means a handful of Enders.
Joe sends the Layla-Fanny Team to the west end of the fish market.

ties.t: A team of Combat Division cadets.

facts.t: Its control unit was fitted between Angela's shoulder blades until Ruby pulled it out.
It is one of the great money houses of Terrinia.
It lent the city money for the Energy System that powers the dome, and for rebuilding each ward after a raid.
A board of the House's elders and partners runs it, and Guinevere's father holds the head seat.
After Guinevere's mother died, the House cleared her rooms.
Guinevere is named heir to her father's seat.
By evening of the Academy's opening day the House knows what the flying figures were.
Guinevere is listed at the Academy as Guinevere of House Baroque.

ties.t: The House sits on its hill.
One of Terrinia's great money houses.

facts.t: It is made up of the House's elders and partners.
It meets in a long room, where Guinevere is given a chair at the back.
It talks in numbers: loans for the dome and for wards rebuilt after raids.
Nobody looks back when Guinevere is named heir; it was arranged.
Guinevere's father puts a detail of guards around her, with Hester at its head; she never leaves the House without them.
They are her only company; they play hide and seek with her and always win, because finding her is their job.
Guinevere carries cakes out to them at the gate herself.
They never come into the long hall; the detail stops at a chair where the hall begins, and nobody sits in it.
They drill in the yard at dawn.
The detail cannot follow Guinevere into the Academy, which guards itself.
Three Enders walk into the old rail yard among the rusted wagons.
When an Ender swings its arm, its chest splits open and its core blazes.
A round in the middle of the core kills an Ender and burns the core black.
The lab handles anything taken off an Ender only with tongs or gloves.
The Shield thinks they can hear its signals.
Their chests split open when they strike, and that is when a round can go in.
On the night the base fell their swarms lean on Lesley's district and hold the Shield at the edge.
After the base fell their raids thin, then stop for a long time.
Years later they come back at night.
They are tall and gray.
They fill the avenue from wall to wall.
Two more big ones come over the roofs before dawn and are brought down.
At the fish market they drop through a tear in the dome.
A claw catches at Guinevere's boot over the lip of the tear.
Guinevere's father lost his wife to them.
It is a giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms.
It walks without hurry, like a machine doing what it was told.
Its chest plates open and light gathers behind them, gold, then white.
Its light comes down on Chang'e's parents and leaves a crater with nothing in it.
While swarms hold the Shield at the edge, it walks through the middle of the city toward the base.
It fires a white beam down on the base's yard, then walks away into the dark.
Years later a giant, gold and black and taller than any tower on the waterfront, stops at the top of the avenue.
Chang'e thinks it is the same one.
It cannot fire with its chest plates shut; the light behind them is the way in.
Lesley's round and Chang'e's crescent go into its open chest together, and it bursts white from inside.
It falls across the top of the avenue, over streets already empty.
Lesley never found out why it went for the base.

things.name: Lesley's rifle
aliases: the rifle Chang'e had built her

facts.t: Its barrel is longer than Chang'e is tall; the test ring holds it while she solders, and she files the bolt smooth twice.
It is red and gold, a gift for Lesley's birthday.
Its bolt slides like a door on good hinges and locks home with a clack.
It has no cell and no cable: only a spring, a pin and a bolt, cocked by hand and fired by finger.
Lesley thinks it will still work in the dark.
Chang'e made it regulation by following the Shield's rulebook.
On the night the base fell its barrel grows hot enough to burn through Lesley's glove.
No rifle Lesley has fired can reach the giant's chest from the rooftops.
Before her longest shot Lesley tells it that distance is just a number.
Lesley fits the new coil on top of its old action.
Lesley keeps the old action because Chang'e built it.

ties.t: Chang'e built it for Lesley's birthday.

facts.t: Chang'e's unsent log line says the coil runs cooler now.
Chang'e leaves the new coil on Lesley's cot.
Lesley fits it on top of her rifle's old action.
It sits on top of the action, new and bright at the seams; Layla takes it for Science Division work.

ties.t: Fitted on top of the old action.

facts.t: The tape on its stock hung in strips when Lesley came back muddy from the city's edge.
The year before, Chang'e's father set its smallest parts.
Lesley sights with it and her real eye both open.
It sits on Lesley's left side and draws the rim of an Ender's core in one thin teal line.
It rings the giant's distant glow in a teal ring no bigger than a coin.
From across the water it draws Chang'e's circling crescents in thin teal lines.
Through it Lesley sees Chang'e strike the stones far across the bay.

ties.t: Chang'e built it, with her father's help.
His hands set its smallest parts.

facts.t: Lesley touches it after the dream, as she always does.
One of Chang'e's unsent lines says Lesley's visor seal is fixed.
It sits at Lesley's collar with a small green light; the base and the Shield can both reach her on it.
On the road Lesley says she is switching to stealth mode and turns it off, and the green light goes out.
It stays off for the whole mission, so no word comes.
It has two channels, the base's and the Shield's.
From the city's edge it cannot reach the base.
Lesley turns its dial to the Shield's channel and leaves it there through the fight.
Before dawn she turns it back to the base's channel; nobody calls.
Years later it stays on the base's channel; her thumb rests on the call switch, but she does not press it.
The gray-bearded officer wears a rank armband on his sleeve.
He brings Lesley an armband that makes her a commander of the Shield's combat division.
She puts it on, though she thinks she held the wrong place.
Lesley signs it with the date every morning.
On her birthday her pen stops on the date, then goes on.
Chang'e borrows it from the gate office and reads it cover to cover.
It says a Shield rifle is worked by hand and needs nothing else.
Chang'e tells Lesley she read the whole book twice.
Lesley hands back anything that is not regulation, such as a lamp and gloves.
Chang'e makes the rifle regulation so Lesley cannot hand it back.
Chang'e tells Lesley the rifle is regulation.
It begins with the night Lesley came back muddy from the city's edge.
Its first page reads: Lesley, my dear, dear protector, I want to make her the best sniper ever!
Every entry after that is written to Lesley.
After the first light Chang'e writes: Lesley, it held! You missed it. Come home. She saves it for Lesley to read at the door.
Years on, the log still runs, every entry to the same name.
On the night of the fall she adds: I'll never forgive you, Lesley. You were not here when we needed your protection. They died because of you!
She saves that entry without sending it.
When the crescents work she writes that she can protect others now, and saves it unsent.
Forty-three one-line drafts to Lesley lie in one folder, each about work, none sent.
She types "Where were you?" under the coil line and decides not to ask it on a screen.
It is a steel hoop taller than Chang'e's father at the back of the lab, with jointed arms that hold work in the air.
Chang'e walls it off with crates and a NO SIS sign while she builds Lesley's rifle.
Its arms open and let the finished rifle down into Lesley's hands.
Chang'e builds her crescents in it, its robot arms holding the pieces while she welds.

ties.t: It stands at the back of the lab.

facts.t: A researcher says it is for grown-ups.
Chang'e falls asleep at it with her soldering iron in her hand.
After the first light the researcher tells Chang'e it is hers.
The two Doctors sit at it with their backs to the room while Chang'e gives Lesley the rifle.
Lesley sets the whole core piece on it past midnight.
A cold box stands under it, holding caramel puddings.
The family photograph stands on it.
At it Chang'e's mother once handed round caramel pudding.
Chang'e's father writes Lesley's load numbers on it.
He folds it into his pocket.
It reads thirty kilos, twenty if she has to run far, in his hand.
It hangs on a nail above the scale while he builds the frame.
A dead core is black and split through, like a coal gone out; Chang'e's mother calls it slag.
Cores burn from the middle.
When the chest splits open to strike, the core blazes close enough to feel its heat.
A round in the middle kills the Ender and burns the core black; a round at the edge might only crack it.
Soldiers believe cores always burn.
Chang'e plans to set a core in a frame's chest, where an Ender keeps it.
In the second year Chang'e seals a core for the next suit in a glass chamber.
When an Ender strikes, its chest plates part and the core burns inside them.
Lesley's round puts the core out, and the Ender falls.
A big Ender's chest plates open on a glowing core as it swings a blow.

ties.t: It sits in an Ender's chest.

facts.t: When Lesley's round cracks a core at the edge, one piece splits off before the burn reaches it and lies whole: a core component, from deep inside the machine.
It is dull when Lesley carries it back in her fist.
For eleven days the needles lie flat when current and heat are run through it.
By the lab's rule it is lifted only with tongs or gloves.
On the twelfth evening, held in Chang'e's bare hands, a small pale light wakes in it.
Its light thins while Lesley is late and flares when she comes back.
In tests its needle climbs when Chang'e thinks of Lesley and drops when she does sums.
Chang'e concludes it responds to what she believes, and only while she holds on.
It is set in a wire cage in the frame's chest.
It makes Lesley the Shield's most valuable shot; Headquarters calls it a miracle.
Lesley wonders if the Enders came for the piece; she does not know.

ties.t: Its heart, in a wire cage.
A piece of an Ender's core.

facts.t: Chang'e's idea is a frame with the core in its chest and a soldier inside, believing.
Chang'e's father bends steel tube into the shape of a person a head taller than Lesley and bolts on gray plates.
The piece sits in a wire cage in its chest; Chang'e fits a copper plate into its open right palm for a hand to press.
If it works, a soldier would wear it: the first suit anyone had ever built.
At first its light holds only to a count of eleven.
At the first light it hums for the first time, the sound coming up through its steel tubes.
After the fall it still stands beside the test ring with the pinned page at its foot.
By the third year finished suits stand beside it.

ties.t: Her idea; she fits the copper plate.
Built at the back of the lab.

facts.t: Chang'e's mother pins the first page of her frame notes to the frame's foot.
It reads: For whoever has to stand in front.
Lesley reads it.
After the first light her mother adds two words under it: First light.
After the fall Chang'e presses its curled corner flat.
Her notes on the frame fill one notebook, then a second, in her quick hand.
After the fall it lies open beside the console at the last page.
The last page reads: First light. Held past three hundred, no shaking. C.'s hand on the plate. Next:
Under "Next:" Chang'e writes in letters twice the size: Make it something a soldier can wear.
Chang'e's mother sets a fourth plate for Lesley at supper.
Its chair faces the door.
Chang'e's mother promises to set Lesley's plate while she is away.
It is set every night for the nine days Lesley is gone.
Riding home, Lesley thinks of it waiting by the chair that faces the door.

ties.with: the small room where the family ate

facts.t: Chang'e's mother puts a fourth stool by the frame, and Lesley comes in at midnight and sits on it.
It stands empty at the first light.
After the first light Chang'e's mother takes three caramel puddings from the cold box under the bench to celebrate.
Chang'e writes SIS on the lid of a fourth cup and puts it at the front of the cold box.
After the fall she pushes the SIS cup to the back, where nobody will see it.
On the founding night Lesley leaves a cup outside the lab door, the spoon laid square across the lid, with no note.
It is the flavor Chang'e's mother handed round, one cup each.
An empty pudding cup sits beside the photograph the next morning.
It shows Chang'e's parents holding her up between them.
On the night of the fall Chang'e lays it face down.
After approving Selena she sets it face up on her desk.
She sits up most of the night with it.
When someone knocks she turns it face down before she is properly awake.
Chang'e climbs up to it to write in her design log.
From afar Lesley sees its pale glow in a lab window.
After the fall it is the only thing still glowing in the lab.
Chang'e sits in her father's chair at it, her feet off the floor.
Chang'e wakes with her cheek on it.
When it goes, every lamp in the lab turns red.
It is tested every week, so Lesley knows its note.
The red lamps die with it.
Years later it goes again when the Enders return.
Lesley says it started when she was halfway to the base.
Chang'e asks whether Lesley will be the first to wear one, and her parents agree.
By the third year finished suits stand beside the old frame, gray plates bolted over steel.
No Shield soldier sent to try them can make a suit lift its arm.
Chang'e says the Shield could not make her suits move.
Chang'e explains they run on aspirant power, which comes from the pilot.
She guesses a suit cares what its pilot believes and how hard, and most grown-ups stopped believing hard long ago.
The first instructor chosen by the dial climbs into a suit and lifts its arms.
At the founding the instructors open wings of light at their backs and fly over the city.
A draft line says the third years' suits passed inspection.
Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela wear combat suits at the ceremony.
The House learns the flying instructors were Shield soldiers in the Academy's first finished suits.
In the second year Chang'e seals a core inside it, with a copper plate in its wall; she lays her palm on the plate, and the core lights.
When she pumps out the air the hum dies and the needles fall, but the light holds.
She writes it down without yet knowing what the finding is good for.
Chang'e designs them under the heading OBJECTIVE: KEEP HERSELF SAFE.
They are crescent pieces, white edged with pink, built in the test ring.
At the first test they rise a hand's width and drop.
At the crater's edge, on her words "Aspirant power, guide me," they rise and circle her until the yard shines white and pink.
Lesley sees a weapon that guards the one inside it and needs nobody else.
They wait for an opening: when an Ender's chest splits to strike, a crescent is already in it, then snaps back into the ring.
One crescent cracks taking a blow meant for Chang'e, and its light goes out.
The gear keeps a running log that records every word, as in every test.
With Lesley at Chang'e's back they fly farther than ever and come back brighter, though she changed nothing.
At dawn they lie dark beside her, one short.
Chang'e calls them up with "Console! Activate!"
Panels of light open in the air around her, and through them she reads the giant's chest.
A red ring on her panel closes over the glow as Lesley locks on.
Lesley carries one hard chair up to the tower room and sets it facing the window, its back to the door.
She sleeps in it, facing the window.
She kicks it over getting up when the Enders return.
In her Academy room the hard chair faces the door.
She sleeps in it upright, boots on, beside a cot nobody has slept on.
Chang'e builds a glove wired to a dial that reads aspirant power.
Lesley's hand goes in first; the glove hums and lights, and the needle swings hard past the line.
Lesley uses it to choose her instructors; most needles stop short of the line.
At the glove's hum some children pull their hands straight back out.
At the first intake, past the line sends a child to the Combat Division's preparatory course, short of it to the Support Division.
One girl's needle hits the stop with a click.
Ruby's needle passes the line with room to spare.
It reads whatever drives Angela's shield as aspirant power too.
It turns its arm back and forth; under the soot on its label tape is Chang'e's mother's small quick handwriting.
It was mended with a trick Chang'e had never seen.
Chang'e buys it for every coin in her pockets and two jelly candies; it stands on the shelf above the bench, still turning its arm.

ties.t: It stood on the corner of the stall's table.

facts.t: The instructors' suits open wings of light at their backs and fly.
Guinevere's wings run on her aspirant power.
When she tires, her wings go out like a switch.
Guinevere sees figures cross the sky on wings of light the day the Academy opens.
She decides money cannot buy those wings.
It sat in a socket between Angela's shoulder blades; the socket is now empty.
Ruby pulled it out so Angela is safe.
Chang'e cannot prove there is no other way in.

ties.t: It was fitted in her back.

facts.t: It is forty lines hidden under Angela's walking routines, behind a lock, with a triangle marked DANGER.
Ruby says it opens to her hand only and lets her stop Angela if Oro ever takes her again.
Chang'e cannot read or open it, so it goes on her list.
Chang'e marks it for weekly checks.
Angela carries it in the crook of her arm.
Its left eye is a camera with a live link to Oro, so Chang'e wants it kept for checks.
Angela folds both arms around it and refuses.
Ruby cuts its link through her glove, and a tiny light goes out.
Ruby says it only sees for Angela now.
The tablet reads LINK: NONE after four seconds; Chang'e once spent a week cutting a link like that.
At the ceremony it is clipped at Angela's hip.

ties.t: It only sees for her now.

facts.t: It glides in behind Ruby and stops by the door, its orange eye lit.
It is white and follows Ruby everywhere, its orange eye on her.
Ruby looped ten minutes of recording into its camera, and it watched that for an hour.
Its lens swings between Lesley and Ruby.
The scan shows a fault in Angela's chest that comes and goes; Chang'e could fix it in a minute.
Angela says it occurs whenever she thinks about the friends she lost, and she does not want it fixed.
Chang'e notes it and does not fix it.
That night Chang'e thinks of it while facing her own unsent lines.
A chibi keychain is a tiny big-headed doll.
Guinevere wears one of a black-haired Vexana, and Vexana one of a pink-haired Guinevere.
It hangs over Lesley's cot, and Chang'e's name has never been on it.
Chang'e had asked Lesley about the rotation at the door that day.
Lesley keeps her off it because in the field she cannot see her.
Asked again to put Chang'e on the rotation, Lesley says no.
After her fall Guinevere straightens her bow.
Hester ties them in Guinevere's hair the first morning it is long enough; she kept them back when the House cleared Guinevere's mother's rooms.
They came from Guinevere's mother's dressing table.
After that Guinevere ties them herself, and nobody else touches them.
She touches them before walking into the Academy.
A picture of a lady hangs in the long hall; Hester tells Guinevere it is her mother.
Guinevere slips and falls on the marble under it.
A lamp hangs under it.

ties.t: It hangs in the long hall.

facts.t: It powers the dome; House Baroque lent the city money for it.
Its pale light shines on the grass behind the Academy hall.
At the fish market it is torn over the stalls.
The tear is a black gash in the dome right above the stalls, and Enders drop through it.
The Energy System powers it, paid for with loans from House Baroque.
House Baroque's board talks of loans for the dome.
Layla knows Guinevere from a billboard.
Guinevere is delighted that it is her.
Small flying craft shaped like cars sweep low over the base's grounds; one fires into the storehouse, and its roof goes up in flame.
They dip and fire over the base's grounds while the giant walks in.
When the Enders return they lift off the roofs and fire at Lesley's lit window.

things.name: the three leaves under a glass dome

facts.t: Layla does not let herself think about three small leaves under a glass dome.
Two round gray drones with cat ears and yellow ring eyes circle Guinevere; they run on her aspirant power.
Light pours from them into an open Ender chest before her fist goes in.
As she tires they fly lower and their yellow rings dim.
When her wings go out they drop with her.
After the fall only one drone rises; the other does not come.
Vexana finds the other in a gutter, one ear bent flat and the bracket under it twisted.
Vexana takes it back through the portal.
That night the drone charger on Guinevere's shelf glows with one cradle empty.
Lesley rides back toward Terrinia after her mission.
On the night the base fell half the city burns, the half with the base in it.
After the fall it has suits, but still nothing that can beat the Enders.
Chang'e becomes the youngest Chief Scientist it has ever had.
House Baroque is one of its great money houses and lends it money for the dome's Energy System and for rebuilding wards after raids.
A blonde girl watches its machines through its outer fence most evenings.
It can call Lesley on its own channel.
It lies far behind the city's edge, down by the water; its radio never reached the edge.
On the night it falls the giant walks straight to it.
That night its gate stands open; the storehouse burns but the lab still stands.
A week after the fall Lesley has two trusted soldiers posted on its gate.
Weeks after the Enders return its gate hangs crooked on one hinge.
It becomes Selrick Academy, with new letters over the old gate.
Lesley never found out why the giant went for it.
Chang'e has a corner of her own in it.
The test ring stands at its back.
When the alarm goes every lamp in it turns red.
It still stands after the night the base fell, its windows red with the alarm.
After the fall it is cold, its door open as they left it.
The old plate on its door said CHIEF SCIENTISTS; the new one drops the last S.
Inside, the old frame and the suits Chang'e finished stand along the wall.
On the founding night its new lamps burn past midnight.
At night it is dark except for the console.

things.name: the small room where the family ate

facts.t: The family eats in a small room; Lesley stands at its door at supper to watch the corridor and the table.
The fourth plate is set there every night Lesley is away.
Lesley signs its gate log every morning.
The gate bolt bangs when Lesley comes back.
The two Doctors walk Lesley down to it at dawn when she leaves on her mission.
Lesley holds the street outside it until no more Enders come.
After the fall it hangs crooked on one hinge.
On the founding morning it opens on new hinges under new letters: SELRICK ACADEMY.
Years before, the two Doctors waited for Lesley at it, and she saluted them.
Guinevere's guard cannot follow her through it; the Academy guards itself.
An Academy guard swings it shut after the last child.
Chang'e borrows the Shield's rulebook from it.
Chang'e carries an armful of springs from the stores.
It stands across the yard; a flying craft fires into it, and its roof goes up in a sheet of flame.
It burns while the lab still stands.
Weeks later it is a black shell by the water.

Layla stands under its five great stars in her combat suit.

facts.t: It is down the corridor from the lab, with a cot and one hard chair facing the door.
Its door is never locked.
The cot is made, its blanket folded square; nobody has ever slept on it.
The field roster hangs over the cot.
Late for class, Layla gallops along it, thinking nobody checks the roof.
Fanny lands on her back there.
Layla and Fanny race down it, each trying to pass on the inside, and roll out into the corridor in a heap.
Its door stands open, and the teacher waits with folded arms as every head turns.
Ruby's looped recording shows her walking to the library.

Lesley asked Ruby her entry question there.
Cadets meet at it before the raid on a shore ward.
Professor Joe sees the third years off at it every day.
Guinevere walks into its light as if it were lit for her.

Vexana goes back through it with the broken drone.
The dome is torn over its stalls.

The raid that matters is on a shore ward.

It stands on a hill above the city.

ties.t: The House's home on its hill.

facts.t: Guinevere's mother's portrait hangs in it.
Her father's office door opens off it.
It is the master's; the guards never come in.
Guinevere's heel slides on its marble, and she falls under the portrait.
Small Guinevere runs down it too fast and lands on both knees on the stone.
On the storm night Hester carries baby Guinevere down to it with one candle.
Nobody goes in until he calls; he speaks to Guinevere through its door.
Guinevere does her accounts again on the bench outside it.
She leaves his birthday cake on that bench.
Behind its door a pen keeps scratching.
Guinevere eats at one end of its long table; her father's chair at the far end stands empty most nights.
Guinevere falls on its steps and is up before Hester reaches her.
She runs out onto it to see the flying suits.
The guards drill in it at dawn.
The guards shout in it the morning the suits fly over.
From her chair at its back Guinevere sees only the top of her father's chair, a fur collar over it, and one hand on the papers.
At bedtime Hester stands in its open door.
From the night of Hester's story on, Guinevere sleeps with its door open.
It stands down in the city by the harbor; Guinevere's mother worked late there on the storm night.
This year Lesley knows which date is hers; it is two weeks off.
She tells nobody, thinking last year was enough.
Chang'e finishes the rifle the night before.
Nobody mentions it all day, which Lesley thinks is correct.
At dusk Chang'e takes her sleeve: her shift ended four minutes ago.
Chang'e unveils the rifle and tells Lesley she will be the best sniper ever.
Chang'e laughs so hard at Lesley's answer that she sits down on the floor.
Three Enders walk into the old rail yard, and a squad goes to ground behind a wagon.
Lesley moves her sight off the middle of the Ender's core to its edge.
A piece of the core splits away whole before the burn reaches it.
Nobody had thought it could be done.
Afterward Shield officers know Lesley by it.

ties.t: It happens at the rail yard.

facts.t: The Shield sends Lesley on a top secret mission because the whole core piece makes her its most valuable shot; she will learn where on the road.
It has no radio and no letters, since the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals.
For its nine days no word comes from Lesley.
It is over when she rides back, and she will never tell anyone what it was.
Years later she still cannot tell Chang'e what it was.
Chang'e's mother calls the moment the frame's light holds for good the first light.
The count passes a hundred, two hundred and six, two hundred and forty-one, three hundred.
The frame hums for the first time.
The light does not shake; it holds.
The family plans to repeat it the next days, and then for Lesley.
Lesley, still away, guesses it came without her or is coming that night.
The notebook records it: held past three hundred, no shaking, C.'s hand on the plate.
Chang'e wants the Academy built where the first light was.
On the evening of the first light the alarm sounds and half the city is burning.
Small flying craft attack the base's grounds and set the storehouse on fire.
A giant Ender walks through the middle of the city.
Its light kills Chang'e's parents as they stand between it and her.
Swarms of Enders hold the Shield at the city's edge.
Lesley calls it a decoy: the edge is held so the giant can walk in.
The giant fires on the base's yard and walks away.
Lesley arrives minutes late and saves Chang'e from an Ender at the crater.
Nobody finds out why the giant went for the base.

things.name: the night the Enders came back

facts.t: After a long quiet the Enders return at night, with fires across the city and sirens.
Chang'e holds the seawall shelter's doors alone.
Lesley draws an Ender off her from the lit tower window.
Mr. Bunny fights as a giant machine.
Lesley and Chang'e bring down a giant together.
They bring down two more big ones before dawn.
Later the Academy calls the two of them the First Aspirants.
Chang'e's crescents fly farther that night with Lesley at her back.
On a bright morning the old gate opens under the name SELRICK ACADEMY.
Lesley becomes Chief Combat Instructor and Chang'e director of the Science Division.
The instructors fly suits in a line over the gate, the crowd and the roofs toward the water.
People cheer along the fence.
Lesley salutes Chang'e; Chang'e salutes back with the wrong hand.
From the House on the hill Guinevere sees the figures cross the sky on wings of light.
Lesley walks the children's homes with stamped sheets and tells the children she chooses to come.
A queue of children runs the length of the yard across the old fifty steps; every one is taller than Chang'e.
Chang'e reads the needle and Lesley asks each child their name and why they are here.
Past the line goes to the Combat Division's preparatory course, short of it to the Support Division; no name goes on a list before the queue is done.
One boy runs back to the gate before his needle settles.
The Combat Division's first intake lists Layla, Guinevere of House Baroque and Vexana.
It tests children Guinevere's age for aspirant power, and nobody can buy a pass.
Children go in with bags over their shoulders; Guinevere's guard detail cannot follow her inside.

things.name: the day the newcomers became Aspirants

facts.t: Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela stand at the front in combat suits; the other students line the walls.
Lesley declares Ruby and Angela Aspirants as of today and says the four stand together.
At dawn Lesley rehearsed the speech under her breath, twice.
She speaks of trusting each other to gain limitless strength.
Vexana waits by the door and Guinevere waves from along the wall.
Layla stands under the five great stars during the last words of the speech.

things.name: the fish-market raid
things.sub: Ender raid on a shore ward

facts.t: It is the only time Guinevere has talked to Layla.
It is a raid on a shore ward, weeks before the ceremony.
Joe sends the Layla-Fanny Team west and Guinevere and Vexana east.
Enders drop through a tear in the dome over the stalls.
Around the thirtieth minute Guinevere's wings go out, and Vexana catches her.
After the last Ender falls a medic tapes Guinevere's wrist, and one drone is found broken.

ties.t: It happens at the fish market.

facts.t: After midnight in a storm every lamp in the House went out at once, and everything that ran on current died.
Even the sirens died; there was only rain, thunder and a violet light at the edges of the shutters.
Hester carried baby Guinevere to the cellar by one candle, counting the steps.
Guinevere's mother was at the House's bank by the harbor and did not come home.
At dawn her father stood a long time in his office door, then shut it.

things.name: the night the roof came down

facts.t: The night the roof came down at Lesley's family house, every lamp died, but the clocks her father wound by hand kept ticking.
Chang'e first finds that a core piece cares what its holder believes, and only while they hold on.
In her report Chang'e crosses out the word belief and writes aspirant power above it.
She says belief sits still, and this reaches.
An aspirant is a person reaching for something with everything in them; that is what lights a core.
The oldest scientist copies the word into his own report.
Chang'e calls on it to lift her crescents.
Suits run on it, and it comes from the pilot.
Chang'e guesses most grown-ups stopped believing hard long ago.
Chang'e's glove and dial measure it.
The dial reads whatever drives Angela's shield as aspirant power too.
Guinevere's drones and wings run on hers.
The Academy's first entrance assessment tests children for it.
An aspirant is a person reaching for something with everything in them.
Lesley makes Ruby and Angela Aspirants as of the day of the ceremony.
Later the Academy calls Lesley and Chang'e the First Aspirants.
The city's scientists make Chang'e Chief Scientist, the youngest Terrinia has ever had.
It had been her parents' title; the old door plate said CHIEF SCIENTISTS, and the new one drops the last S.
Lesley becomes the Academy's Chief Combat Instructor, head of its Combat Division.
Chang'e proposes finding children young and teaching them in pairs.
She says hearts that believe in each other become their strength.
Lesley says a cadet who does not look back is bad in a pair.
After the ceremony the students go out in twos.
Chang'e checks Angela the way she checks a machine: joint torque, sensor reach, cooling.
Chang'e rules that anything that can receive can be told what to do, so Angela stays on checks.
What Chang'e cannot open goes on her list.
She writes WEEKLY beside the safeguard's lock.
Chang'e admits keeping Angela on checks is the same as Lesley keeping her off the rotation.
Students caught skipping class can be kept in detention all day.
Detention is cleaning the Academy hall.
It is Fanny's first.
Angela comes though nobody sentenced her.
The bell ends it.
Flying is banned on school grounds.
It is the manners tutor's phrase for how a lady holds her back.
Guinevere glues it to Hester's count.
After a fall she announces it: a lady's refinement, three seconds.
After Vexana pulls her up, she calls it the way to regain your elegance in three seconds.
Hester counts "One. Two. Three." when Guinevere falls, and Guinevere stands on three.
Soon Guinevere counts with her.
On the storm night Hester counted the steps aloud so the baby would not cry.
When nobody comes, Guinevere counts herself up.
Vexana counts under her breath while Guinevere recovers, reaching four.
Guinevere counts one, two, three in bed after the raid.
It replays the night the base fell and always ends on a child's voice.
In the dream, years later, Chang'e's quiet "Leave me alone" becomes a shout.
It ends on "Go away! Leave me alone!"
After it Lesley always touches her visor.
Cores come back to the lab in a raid crate.
Lesley leads her first raid in command as a Shield commander.
After the base fell the raids thin, then stop for a long time.
Guinevere and Vexana fight raids together as cadets.
House Baroque lends money to rebuild each ward after a raid.
